name: September
focus: The Comeback (winback month) + 57 Days to Diwali
objective: Winback month: manager calls for high-value lapsed clients, fast comebacks for recent lapsers; a results-guarantee bundle; lock 3M plans before the festive dip.
strategy:
The Comeback + 57 Days to Diwali.

Commercial job: Winback month: manager calls for high-value lapsed clients, fast comebacks for recent lapsers; a results-guarantee bundle; lock 3M plans before the festive dip.

Lapsed: We Need to Talk (“We need to talk. Not like that — we just miss you.”). These clients bought big before; a long plan at a serious price fits them. A personal call converts better than a broadcast.

Lapsed: New Phone, Who Dis? (“New phone, who dis? (It's us. Your favourite class.)”). A free first step lowers the barrier; the 7-day window keeps the decision fast. The freeze has no cash cost.

Newcomer: Glow-Up or Give Back (“57 days to Diwali. Glow up, or we give back.”). New clients' first 60-day spend averages ₹11,150 at Kwality, ₹8,411 at Bandra and ₹6,747 at Kenkere — under one month's list price. A 2-month bundle doubles it; the 30-class condition makes the guarantee rarely paid.

Renewal: Lock It Before the Laddoos (“Lock it before the laddoos.”). October–December are troughs (Kwality Nov-25 ₹18.5L; Bandra Oct-25 ₹10.2L). Locking 3M before the festive season protects the base.
notes: Build: 85 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹9.5L; 93 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹21.8L; 41 winbacks = ₹4.8L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.6L. Offers carry ₹23.6L (59% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

funnel.dataQuality: lead→trial = CRM 'Trial Completed' status (not attendance-verified); trial→member = trailing measured; see dataGaps
